description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

  Your opportunity 

 New Relic is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to join our IT Engineering team, with a focus on network infrastructure and enterprise AI enablement. You will build and operate the networks that keep our global workforce connected and secure, and you will help deploy AI tools that make the company faster. This is an engineering role built around automation, scalability, and reliability, with real ownership over the platforms you run.

 We are looking for a systems thinker who automates repetitive work, writes clear documentation, and makes sound tradeoffs between security, usability, and speed of adoption. You will partner with Security, Compliance, Facilities, IT Support, and Engineering teams, and you will have room to lead projects and shape the roadmap.

 What you'll do 

 You will own and improve core network infrastructure across our global offices while driving the technical rollout and governance of AI platforms across the company. Day-to-day responsibilities include:

 Network and infrastructure 

 
 Design, deploy, and manage Meraki infrastructure across global offices using the Meraki Dashboard and APIs

 Troubleshoot and resolve office network issues, including Wi-Fi, switching, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, and connectivity problems.

 Manage ISP relationships, including circuit procurement, installs, renewals, SLAs, outage escalation, and domain performance tracking

 Plan and execute office network builds, moves, and refreshes with Facilities and Security

 Design, deploy, and operate Zero Trust and network security infrastructure (Cloudflare Zero Trust/WARP, VPN, firewall policy)

 Monitor network health and capacity, respond to incidents, and drive root cause fixes

 Maintain network documentation, including architecture diagrams, IP plans, runbooks, and SOPs

 
 AI enablement 

 
 Deploy and administer enterprise AI platforms (Gemini Enterprise, Claude, and related tools), including configuration, integrations, and usage monitoring

 Build AI-powered automations that reduce manual work across IT and business teams

 Design and enforce AI usage controls, including data protection, DLP, audit logging, and access policies

 Evaluate new AI tools and vendors, running pilots and recommending adoption based on measurable impact

 
 Team and operations 

 
 Build integrations and automation using scripts and APIs to eliminate manual toil

 Act as an escalation point for IT Support on complex network and infrastructure issues

 Participate in a global on-call rotation

 
 This role requires 

 
 2 years of experience in network, infrastructure, or IT engineering

 Strong networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, TLS, VPN, proxy, firewall) and proven troubleshooting skills

 Hands-on experience managing Meraki or comparable enterprise network infrastructure

 Experience working with ISPs and carriers, including circuit management and outage escalation

 Hands-on experience with enterprise AI or LLM platforms (Gemini, Claude or similar), including administration or integration work

 Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (Python, Bash, JavaScript) and experience building against REST APIs

 Understanding of data security principles as they apply to AI usage (data classification, DLP, least privilege)

 Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills

 Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document designs and teach others

 Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams

 
 Bonus points if you have 

 
 Cisco Meraki certification (CMNA) or CCNA/Network+

 Experience with SD-WAN design and multi-site network management

 Experience with Cloudflare Zero Trust, DLP, or CASB tooling

 Experience building agents or workflows with MCP, prompt engineering, or LLM APIs

 Experience with infrastructure as code or workflow automation (Terraform, Ansible, n8n, or similar)

 Experience supporting SOX or similar compliance controls

 Experience administering SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, or Atlassian

 Experience running AI adoption programs, training, or internal enablement

 
 Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

 Qualified applicants may inquire about visa sponsorship (including transfer of a current H-1B visa), but the company does not support or sponsor O-1, F-1, or J-1 visas, or candidates who require commencement of an H-1B "cap case" petition for future work authorization. This position is to be filled as soon as possible. 
 

   

 #LI-MM4 #LI-Remote
 The pay range below represents a reasonable estimate of the salary for the listed position. This role is eligible for a corporate bonus plan. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related factors such as an applicant’s skills, qualifications, and experience.

 New Relic provides a variety of benefits for this role, including healthcare, dental, vision, parental leave and planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, flex time-off, 11 paid holidays, volunteer time-off, and other competitive benefits designed to improve the lives of our employees.

 Estimated Base Pay Range
 $95,000 — $119,000 USD 


 Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes. 

 If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com .

 We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

 Our hiring process 

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the  San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance .

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.

 New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.

 Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics. 

 Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at  https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy
